floater.string: Inventory is still loading, results may be incomplete.
Cannot save: this rule's ruleset no longer exists.

line_editor.name: search_text
line_editor.tool_tip:
Text compared with each item or folder name, using Search type. Several terms: separate them with ';', any term can match (not for Regex: use '|'). A term containing '/' is compared with the full path from My Inventory instead of the name.
Examples: Contains: demo;sample;test Starts with: [DEMO] Ends with: (copy) Exact: Old Shoes v2 Starts with: /Objects/Old/ (everything inside /Objects/Old) Regex: ^demo|demo$ Regex: /Objects/.*demo.* (demo anywhere inside /Objects) Regex: \bv[0-9]+$ (names ending with a version like v2)

combo_box.name: search_type
combo_box.tool_tip: How the Search text is compared: Contains: anywhere in the name (or path) Starts with / Ends with: at the beginning / end Regex: regular expression, found anywhere (use ^ and $ to anchor) Exact: the whole name (or path)

line_editor.name: except_text
line_editor.tool_tip:
Items and folders to ignore, using Except type. An ignored folder is ignored with everything inside it. Same syntax as Search: ';' separates terms (not for Regex: use '|'), a term containing '/' is compared with the full path.
Examples: Exact: /Clothing/Demos;/Objects/Keep (skip these two folders) Contains: keep;fav (skip anything named with keep or fav) Starts with: /Outfits/ (skip everything inside Outfits) Regex: ^#|^~ (skip names starting with # or ~)

combo_box.name: except_type
combo_box.tool_tip: How the Except text is compared, same choices as Search type.

floater.text: Links are ignored. Worn items can be moved but are never deleted. Trash, Current Outfit, My Outfits, Marketplace Listings and protected folders are never searched. A matching folder is moved or deleted with all its contents.
